source_lineage.m4_instruction: Applicability checkpoint before implementation; do not invent a lifecycle.

authority_boundary: External systemd timer, cron, or Windows Task Scheduler invokes the one-shot CLI.
Explicit CLI invocation invokes the same execute_crawl/run_all path.
Dashboard CrawlController invokes execute_crawl in a background thread; its auto/manual trigger is in-memory controller state only.
execution_model.control_flow: execute_crawl -> run_all -> run_started -> run_source -> run_finished -> notifier.drain

provenance.scheduled_manual_distinction: not persisted; dashboard trigger is an in-memory status field and scheduler wrappers call the same one-shot command
provenance.unknown: no provenance field or qualification consumer exists

prior_evidence_consumption.effect: due/health/telemetry behavior only; no promotion or maturity decision

qualification_gate.production_promotion: README posture is UNVERIFIED_PRODUCTION / promotion frozen, not an application gate

epoch_reset.documented_database_epochs: manual archive/reset bookkeeping only; no epoch column

downstream_provenance_fabrication.finding: No qualification gate or downstream qualification consumer exists, so there is no trusted provenance path to fabricate.

applicability_test.interpretation: Telemetry and catalog/evidence observations persist, but they do not accumulate as reusable soak evidence or justify a production decision.

resolver_trigger_fact_analysis.assessment: M1 correctly treated the absent fact as unresolved rather than FALSE; generic sku-based profile scope did not prove a promotion/soak lifecycle. Source inspection now establishes that the lifecycle is absent.
resolver_trigger_fact_analysis.required_follow_up: Separate Standards-only applicability-record correction; no frozen-standard or resolver redesign in this checkpoint.

real_governed_behaviour.description: One-shot invocation telemetry, due gating, source/output health, catalog diffs, notifications, and evidence observation storage.

rationale: OEM Radar is explicitly stateless one-shot collection driven by external scheduler/manual/dashboard invocation.
Durable crawler_runs and related records are telemetry, health, catalog-diff, delivery, and evidence-observation state, not reusable qualification evidence.
No promotion/soak maturity gate consumes prior evidence to authorize production behavior.
No qualification material identity, epoch, or reset boundary exists; adding one would create a new lifecycle rather than repair an existing risk.
The README's UNVERIFIED_PRODUCTION / promotion-frozen posture is a deployment/release posture, not a qualification gate.
The evidence architecture explicitly leaves an evidence-promotion path undefined, and the documented database epochs are operational archive bookkeeping.

known_evidence.known_evidence_generator_effect: ignored; no Operations known-evidence entry is produced
